about: The Tire Speed Calculator determines vehicle speed based on tire size, gear ratios, and engine RPM. Essential for speedometer calibration, gear ratio selection, and performance analysis.
This tool helps understand how tire size changes affect actual vehicle speed, speedometer accuracy, and overall drivetrain performance across different driving conditions.
howToUse: Input gear ratios and differential ratio
View calculated vehicle speed and speedometer error

faqs.question: How do larger tires affect speedometer readings?
faqs.answer: Larger tires make the speedometer read slower than actual speed. A 3% tire diameter increase typically causes the speedometer to read 3% low.

faqs.question: What gear ratios should I consider for tire changes?
faqs.answer: When increasing tire size, consider numerically higher gear ratios to maintain acceleration. Conversely, smaller tires may benefit from numerically lower ratios.

faqs.question: How accurate are tire speed calculations?
faqs.answer: Calculations are highly accurate when using precise tire dimensions and gear ratios. Real-world factors like tire pressure and wear can cause minor variations.

faqs.question: Can this help with transmission selection?
faqs.answer: Yes, by showing how different gear ratios affect speed at various RPMs, helping choose optimal transmission ratios for your tire size and performance goals.
